items.source: Invoking this method will not end the current transaction. Rather, the value of this flag will be used to determine whether the current test-managed transaction should be rolled back or committed once it is ended.
items.translation: 调用此方法将不会结束当前事务。相反，该标志的值将用于确定一旦当前测试管理的事务结束后，是回滚还是提交。

items.source: Immediately force a commit or rollback of the current test-managed transaction, according to the rollback flag.
items.translation: 立即根据回滚标志强制提交或回滚当前测试管理的事务。

items.source: Determine whether the current test-managed transaction has been flagged for rollback or flagged for commit.
items.translation: 确定当前由测试管理的交易是否已 标记为回滚 或 标记为提交。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if no transaction is active for the current test
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果当前测试没有激活的事务

items.source: Support for TestTransaction is automatically available whenever the TransactionalTestExecutionListener is enabled. Note that the TransactionalTestExecutionListener is typically enabled by default, but it can also be manually enabled via the @TestExecutionListeners annotation.
items.translation: 对 `TestTransaction` 的支持在启用 `TransactionalTestExecutionListener` 时自动可用。请注意，`TransactionalTestExecutionListener` 通常默认启用，但也可以通过 `@TestExecutionListeners` 注解手动启用。

items.source: Consult the javadocs for TransactionalTestExecutionListener for a detailed explanation of test-managed transactions.
items.translation: 请查阅 `TransactionalTestExecutionListener` 的 javadocs，以获取有关测试管理的交易的详细解释。

items.source: Only call this method if end() has been called or if no transaction has been previously started.
items.translation: 仅当已调用end()或尚未启动任何事务时，才调用此方法。

items.source: Determine whether a test-managed transaction is currently active.
items.translation: 确定当前是否有一个由测试管理的活动事务。

items.source: true if the current test-managed transaction is flagged to be rolled back; false if the current test-managed transaction is flagged to be committed
items.translation: 如果当前测试管理的交易被标记为回滚，则为`true`；如果被标记为提交，则为`false`。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if a transaction is not active for the current test
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果当前测试没有激活事务

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the transaction context could not be retrieved or if a transaction is already active for the current test
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果无法检索事务上下文，或者当前测试已存在活动事务

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the transaction context could not be retrieved or if a transaction is not active for the current test
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果无法获取事务上下文，或者当前测试没有活动的事务

items.source: true if a test-managed transaction is currently active
items.translation: true 表示当前存在由测试管理的活动事务。

items.source: Flag the current test-managed transaction for commit.
items.translation: 标记当前由测试管理的交易以进行提交。

items.source: Flag the current test-managed transaction for rollback.
items.translation: 标记当前测试管理的交易以进行回滚。
启动一个新的由测试管理的事务。
